CITY OF ALHAMBRA PLANNING COMMISSION
  ACTION MINUTES

  Regular Meeting
  July 18, 2022

  The audio and video recordings of the meeting are available here: PC Meeting – July 18, 2022
  (Audio).m4a / PC Meeting – July 18, 2022 (Video).mp4

A.  CALL MEETING TO ORDER:  7:00 P.M. via video conference and teleconference.

B.  ROLL CALL:

  Present:  Ho, Juarez, Mojarro, Olson, Pham, Sahu, Tsujii, Wang, Garcia, Gardea

  Absent:  None

  Staff Present: Vanessa Reynoso, Deputy Director; Paul Lam, Principal Planner;
  Deanna Evans, Contract Associate Planner; Alondra Espinosa, Deputy City
  Attorney

C.  FLAG SALUTE:  Led by President Gardea

D.  ELECTION OF OFFICERS FOR 2022-2023:

  Nomination and election of President, Vice-President, and Secretary of the Planning Commission
  for 2024-2025, in accordance with AM 2.24.050.

  MOTION:
  •  Moved to elect Antonio Gardea as President, Eric Garcia as Vice
  President, and the Director of Community Development as Secretary of
  the Planning Commission.
  •  Moved by Commissioner Sahu, Seconded by Commissioner Wang.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 10-0-0-0
  Ayes:  Ho, Juarez, Mojarro, Olson, Pham, Sahu, Tsujii, Wang,
  Garcia, Gardea
  Noes:  None
  Abstain: None
  Absent:  None

E.  CONSENT AGENDA:

  •  There were no Consent Agenda items.

F.  DISCUSSION ITEMS:

  •  There were no Discussion Items.

G.  PUBLIC HEARINGS:

  1
  07/18/2022
 AGENDA
ITEM 1:  PLANNED DEVELOPMENT PERMIT PD-22-04, CONDITIONAL USE
  PERMIT CUP-22-02 & VARIANCE VAR-22-01 (7:06 P.M.)
  • 2142 South Fremont Avenue
  • Request: This is an application for a Planned Development Permit,
  Conditional Use Permit and Variance to establish a martial arts studio
  in a lease space previously used as a medical office on an
  approximate land area of 36,643 square feet located in the CPD
  (Commercial Planned Development) zone. The Variance is
  requested to reduce the number of required on-site parking spaces.
  (This application is exempt from the California Environmental Quality
  Act.)
  • Recommended Action: Adopt Resolution 22-21 approving Planned
  Development Permit PD-22-04, Conditional Use Permit CUP-22-02
  & Variance VAR-22-01, subject to the Conditions of Approval.
  • Principal Planner Paul Lam provided the Staff presentation.
  • Michael Medina and Alex Flores, the Applicants, were available to
  answer questions.
  •  The public hearing was opened and then closed.
MOTION:
  •  Moved to approve Agenda Item 1 with the following added Condition of
  Approval: (1) There shall be no more than six (6) instructors and students
  in any combination on the business premises at any one time, with the
  exception of occasional special events.
  •  Moved by Commissioner Sahu, Seconded by Commissioner Wang.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:
  Roll Call Vote: 10-0-0-0
  Ayes:  Ho, Juarez, Mojarro, Olson, Pham, Sahu, Tsujii, Wang,
  Garcia, Gardea
  Noes:  None
  Abstain: None
  Absent:  None
AGENDA
ITEM 2:  PLANNED DEVELOPMENT PERMIT PD-21-48 (7:37 P.M.)
  • 234 South Curtis Avenue
  • Request: This is an application for a Planned Development Permit
  to construct a four-unit apartment complex on an approximate land
  area of 7,500 square feet located in the R-3 (Multiple Family
  Residential) zone.
  • Recommended Action: Adopt Resolution 22-25 approving Planned
  Development Permit PD-21-48, subject to the Conditions of
  Approval.
  • Contract Planner Deanna Evans provided the Staff presentation.
  • Henry Ho and Vincent Tsoi, SLS Design Inc., the Applicants, were
  available to answer questions.
  • The public hearing was opened and then closed.
  • Public Comments:
  1.) Jennifer Ng
  2.) Bert Ng
  3.) Cary
  2
  07/18/2022
 MOTION:
  •  Moved to approve Agenda Item 2 with the following added Condition of
  Approval: (1) The Developer or Property Owner shall hire an architectural
  salvage professional familiar with the salvation of elements of historic
  homes.
  •  Moved by Commissioner Sahu, Seconded by Commissioner Olson.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 9-1-0-0
  Ayes:  Ho, Juarez, Mojarro, Olson, Pham, Sahu, Tsujii, Wang,
  Gardea
  Noes:  Garcia
  Abstain: None
  Absent:  None

AGENDA
ITEM 3:  CONDITIONAL USE PERMIT CUP-21-02 (8:27 P.M.)
  • 2000 West Main Street
  • Request: This is an application for a Conditional Use Permit to add
  live entertainment to an existing restaurant on an approximate land
  area of 160,253 square feet located in the CPD (Commercial Planned
  Development) zone and AC (Automobile Commercial) overlay
  district.
  • Recommended Action: Adopt Resolution 22-26 approving
  Conditional Use Permit CUP-21-02, subject to the Conditions of
  Approval.
  • Principal Planner Paul Lam provided the Staff presentation.
  • Jun Yang, Xing Yang, Rui Wang, and Jaxx Chi Yeh, the
  Applicants, were available to answer questions.
  • The public hearing was opened and then closed.

MOTION:
  •  Moved to approve Agenda Item 3 with added Conditions of Approval to
  PL4 and PL24: (1)The business shall close no later than 2:00 AM daily.
  (2) At the request of the Community Development Director, the Planning
  Commission may modify or add conditions of approval should the
  impacts anticipated at the time of approval turn out to be greater and or
  different, including, but not limited to noise and police calls for service.
  •  Commissioner Wang added a friendly amendment to add the following
  added Conditions of Approval to PL6, PL8, and PL9: (1) The live
  entertainment shall be ancillary to the primary restaurant use and shall
  be limited to a live DJ, a live band, live singers, and traditional Chinese
  dance performances. (2) There shall be no stage dancers, pole dancers,
  Go-Go dancers, or any other form of dancers as part of the live
  entertainment, except for traditional Chinese dancers. (3) No dance floor
  for patrons shall be allowed on the premises.
  •  Moved by Commissioner Sahu, Seconded by Commissioner Olson.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 10-0-0-0

  3
  07/18/2022
   Ayes:  Ho, Juarez, Mojarro, Olson, Pham, Sahu, Tsujii, Wang,
  Garcia, Gardea
  Noes:  None
  Abstain:  None
  Absent:  None

H.  DIRECTOR’S REPORT:

  •  Deputy Director Vanessa Reynoso provided an update on the Historic
  Preservation program including the city-wide survey and development of the
  preservation ordinance, along with updates to the Zoning Code. (9:11 P.M.)

I.  ORAL COMMUNICATIONS:

  •  Jennifer Ng thanked staff for the update on the Director’s Report. She inquired
  about the follow-up to the Condition of Approval to Agenda Item 2. (9:15 P.M.)
  •  Helen Fong commented on noise coming from Havana and La Chuperia. (9:16
  P.M.)
  •  Michelle commented on noise coming from Havana and La Chuperia. (9:20 P.M.)

J.  COMMISSION COMMUNICATIONS/ANNOUNCEMENTS:

  •  Commissioner Wang commented on PL24, and possibly taking another look at the
  Conditions of Approval on the previous projects. (9:28 P.M.)
  •  Vice President Garcia voiced support of follow-up and confirmation on the
  Condition of Approval for Agenda Item 2 regarding the architectural salvage. (9:30
  P.M.)

K.  ADJOURNMENT:

  •  There being no other business, the meeting was adjourned at 9:31 P.M. to Monday,
  August 1, 2022, at 7:00 P.M.
